about: Keeper's files contract vectors (syncular/README.md, The drive; story 116.1). Hand-written, never generated; every implementation reproduces each entry (keeper's in keeper-files-api and keeper-paths tests). Format: fixtures are manifests (bulk rows expand to count live text/markdown files with ids prefix + zero-padded n); a case's steps run in order on its fixture, each through the reference evaluator, and its expect is a subset of the result (or a refusal code with nothing changed).
